item.title: - Pauli Matrices and Rotation
item.description: 1. Vector Space of Traceless Hermitian Matrices # (1) Basis: ${\sigma_x, \sigma_y, \sigma_z}$ # $\mathbf{\sigma} = (\sigma_x, \sigma_y, \sigma_z)$ $\mathbf{n} = (n_x, n_y, n_z)$ $\mathbf{n} \cdot \mathbf{\sigma} = n_x \sigma_x + n_y \sigma_y + n_z \sigma_z \in V$ Inner product: $X \cdot Y = \frac{1}{2}\text{tr}(XY)$ (2) Basis: ${\frac{1}{2}\sigma_x, \frac{1}{2}\sigma_y, \frac{1}{2}\sigma_z}$ # $\tilde{\sigma}_x = \frac{1}{2}\sigma_x$, $\tilde{\sigma}_y = \frac{1}{2}\sigma_y$, $\tilde{\sigma}_z = \frac{1}{2}\sigma_z$ $\mathbf{\tilde{\sigma}} = (\tilde{\sigma}_x, \tilde{\sigma}_y, \tilde{\sigma}_z)$ $\mathbf{n} = (n_x, n_y, n_z)$ $\mathbf{n} \cdot \mathbf{\tilde{\sigma}} = n_x \tilde{\sigma}_x + n_y \tilde{\sigma}_y + n_z \tilde{\sigma}_z \in V$ Inner product: $X \cdot Y = 2 \text{tr}(XY)$ 2.
